One of the most heartbreaking songs ever made Mann Bharrya by B Praak — out on Speed Records.
With B Praak's soul-shattering vocals and Jaani's unforgettable lyrics, Mann Bharrya became an all-time anthem of heartbreak and lost love — a song that struck a chord with millions. Starring Himanshi Khurana, directed by Arvindr Khaira. Feel every word.
